title: FieldToFit · 关于 FieldToFit
FieldToFit · About FieldToFit
heading: FIELD → FIT
FIELD → FIT
description: FieldToFit 是人与 AI 共享的动态 AI 地图：看清已有方案，判断是否适配，选择正确的采用与构建路线。
FieldToFit is a living AI map shared by people and AI: understand existing solutions, judge their fit, and choose the right path to adopt or build.

title: FieldToFit · FieldToFit 社区
FieldToFit · FieldToFit Community
heading: FieldToFit 社区
FieldToFit Community
description: FieldToFit 计划逐步建立一个围绕 AI 应用的共建社区，建设持续更新、可追溯、人与 AI 都能使用的 AI 应用资料库（AI Application Database）。
FieldToFit plans to build a community around AI applications: a continuously maintained, traceable AI Application Database for people and AI.

title: FieldToFit · 数据来源
FieldToFit · Sources
heading: 关注谁，从哪里发现。
Who we follow. Where we discover.
description: 重点对象和发现渠道共用真实来源配置。已接入、已采集和已发布分别展示；每 1 天检查，有值得发布的内容再整理审核。
Tracked organizations and discovery channels share actual configuration. Connection, collection and publication are separate; sources are checked daily and content is reviewed before publication.
